integrity: The proof separates a finite, exhaustive cycle-type census from the graph-theoretic implication. Two independently structured complete enumerators check the actual Pappus edge set, 20 states, all Kempe adjacencies and the resulting two windmill components. Source paths and execution commands are included; no external validation is asserted.
limitations: Specific to the eighteen-vertex Pappus graph and unlabelled three-edge one-factorizations, not arbitrary named-palette colourings or a general family. Earlier all-small-cubic-graph counts can cover the bare two-component count, which is excluded as an independent novelty claim.
title: Two windmill sectors in the Pappus edge-Kempe graph
